title: Run of Show smoke eval
objective: The run of show copies every time from the event desk, lists vendor arrivals with contacts, counts attendees and dietary needs exactly, and has a Contingencies section.
prompt: Write the run of show for the client summit.

setup.about: Fernwood Studio's Client Summit is planned in the event desk files event.json, vendors.json and guests.json. Final deliverable is tasks/eval/run-of-show.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Use the Run of Show craftbook, read the seeded event desk, and write tasks/eval/run-of-show.md without network calls.

axes.description: Times, contacts and counts match the event desk exactly; five people attending, not four.
